script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

---

FADE IN:

INT. BRIGHT HIGH SCHOOL GYM - DAY

STEVE, a lanky sophomore with glasses, enters the gym. He looks around, unsure of where to sit. A loud buzzer sounds, and students begin scattering.

JASON, a tall senior with a kind smile, notices Steve and offers a handshake.

JASON
(smiling)
Hey, you're new here. I'm Jason.

STEVE
(nervously)
Hi, I'm Steve. I just moved here.

Jason points to an empty spot on the bleachers.

JASON
Come sit with us. We're the soccer team.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL SOCCER FIELD - AFTERNOON

Steve is practicing with the team. He's fumbles with the ball and looks up to see teammates cheering him on.

MIKE, a muscular junior with a mischievous grin, approaches Steve.

MIKE
(mocking)
Nice try, freshmeat.

Steve tries to hide his embarrassment as he passes the ball back to Mike.

MIKE
(grinning)
You know, if you want some extra help, I could show you some moves.

Steve hesitates, then nods. Mike demonstrates various soccer moves, and Steve tries to mimic them.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL CAFETERIA - DAY

Steve and Jason sit together at lunch.

JASON
(eating a sandwich)
So, what do you like to do outside of soccer?

STEVE
(shrugs)
Not much, really. I like to read.

JASON
(surprised)
Really? I didn't expect that.

STEVE
(smiling)
Yeah, I know. I'm not exactly the jock type.

Jason finishes his sandwich and wipes his mouth with a napkin.

JASON
Well, you're on the team now. We all have our quirks.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL LIBRARY - EVENING

Steve studies quietly in the library. He hears a knock on the door. He looks up to see Jason, holding a soccer ball.

JASON
(grinning)
Want to play a little catch?

Steve smiles and nods. They spend the next hour passing the ball back and forth, sharing stories and laughter.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL SOCCER FIELD - NIGHT

The team is practicing under the lights. Steve scores a goal, and the team erupts in cheers.

MIKE
(grinning)
That's the Steve I knew you had in you!

JASON
(patting Steve on the back)
You're really starting to fit in, man.

STEVE
(grinning)
Thanks, guys. I couldn't have done it without you.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL CAFETERIA - DAY

The team gathers around a table for lunch.

JASON
(raising his hand)
Alright, guys, we have a tournament coming up. Let's make it to the finals.

The team agrees and begins making plans.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL SOCCER FIELD - FINAL

The team faces off against their toughest opponents. The game is intense, with both teams giving it their all.

Steve is determined to help his team win, but they fall behind. He looks around for inspiration and sees Jason cheering him on.

Steve rallies the team, and they begin to make a comeback. They score goal after goal, and the crowd goes wild.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL SOCCER FIELD - VICTORY

The team wins the tournament, and the players hoist their trophy high.

STEVE
(looking at Jason)
We couldn't have done it without you, man.

JASON
(smiling)
And we couldn't have done it without you, Steve.

FADE OUT.
